comment: The Center button is the parameter the maker never named here, so it carries a blank tooltip; the same button on GeneticTerrain is named CENTER, GeneticTerrain.cpp:117. A parameter for a SIMD setting is configured with no widget, so no click reaches it. The module shares its file and its terrain formulas with GeneticTerrain, GeneticTerrain.cpp:692, and differs in drawing its curve from the superformula rather than from a named plane curve. The maker's own advice in the README is not to use the module at all, and then how to use it: keep to curves where the two symmetry numbers are equal and avoid sharp, pointed shapes.
